extra_description.text: The day you realised all of this could actually be learned.
It all starts with one Poké Ball and a lot of misses.
It is all in the wrist.
A thousand throws, a thousand corrections.
You will never look at a bush the same way again.
Waiting for the right turn is an art.
At night, colours lie a little less.
Before it even realises what happened.
A shard of comet in your pocket.
They say you never missed a throw again.
Sometimes you have to defend yourself.
Wild Pokémon do not bring a referee.
Now you are the one teaching.
Days on the road are long.
You are the one handing out the badge now.
They can tell when you care.
